# Crystal Ball of True Seeing (`magic-items:crystal-ball-of-true-seeing`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Legendary | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you have Truesight with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.
